description: A new artifact trail sends Lara through Brazil, New Orleans, frozen fortresses and lost cities as rivals and old allies converge around another world-scale danger.

s02e01.description: A mysterious ally leads Lara to a technological utopia where a powerful benefactor challenges the direction of her legacy.

s02e02.description: During a festival in Brazil, Lara clashes with a ruthless rival over an artifact capable of causing much wider damage.

s02e03.description: Lara’s pursuit of a sacred mask takes her through New Orleans and into a dangerous underwater encounter where folklore becomes tangible.

s02e04.description: Inside a frozen stronghold, a long-awaited reunion turns into a confrontation that threatens Lara’s mission and personal loyalties.

s02e05.description: An undercover operation at an extravagant gala leaves Lara trapped behind enemy lines during a tightening security lockdown.

s02e06.description: Lara and Sam dive off Cuba in search of a lost Orisha mask as the larger conflict moves toward open confrontation.

s02e07.description: With the world destabilising, Lara and Eshu explore a lost African city for answers buried in his past.

s02e08.description: Lara gathers a resistance for the final confrontation as ancient forces awaken and the consequences become global.
